modules: 进程、数据目录与健康检查
启动 hearthd 并固定默认端口、~/.hearth 数据目录、日志位置和 /health。服务必须能在空目录初始化、重复启动不损坏状态、退出时留下明确的恢复点。
事件日志与读取投影
SQLite 使用 WAL；状态变化只写事件，任务卡、详情、收件箱和成本从投影读取。实现最小 migration 与 replay，确认重放不会产生外部副作用。
最小 Task/Run 状态机
用 fake executor 跑通创建、排队、分配、执行、完成、失败、取消和恢复。每次迁移都要有事件、条件和审计字段，不允许页面直接改状态列。
Web、SSE 与 CLI 闭环
Web 支持创建任务、列表、详情和实时进度；刷新或重启后从持久状态恢复。CLI 只做 init、status、inspect、replay、doctor，不成为产品主入口。
Process, data directory, and health
Start hearthd with fixed port, ~/.hearth data directory, log location, and /health. It must initialize an empty directory, survive repeated starts, and leave a clear recovery point on exit.
Event log and read projections
Use SQLite WAL. State changes write events only; task cards, details, inbox, and cost read projections. Add minimal migration and replay, confirming replay cannot cause external effects.
Minimal Task/Run state machine
Use the fake executor for create, queue, assign, run, complete, fail, cancel, and recover. Every transition has an event, guard, and audit field; pages never edit state columns.
Web, SSE, and CLI loop
The Web app creates tasks, lists them, shows details, and streams progress. Refresh or restart restores from durable state. The CLI only supports init, status, inspect, replay, and doctor.
Codex adapter 与健康边界
封装版本探测、登录/模型可用性检查、超时、取消和错误分类；adapter 不解释长期偏好，不自行扩大权限，也不直接写主数据库。
一次性 workspace 与来源映射
每次 Run 创建隔离工作区，只挂载 Task Pack 允许的输入，保留输入文件、读取记录、输出 diff 和产物哈希，确保结果可以追溯。
Task Pack 与结构化结果
明确目标、输入、约束、输出 schema、验收和预算；要求模型返回固定字段，拒绝缺文件、无依据引用或超出范围的修改。
产物、验证与执行投影
把 Codex 事件转成标准 ExecutorEvent，记录 Artifact、引用、验证、Token、模型、延迟和失败类别；UI 时间线只展示用户需要理解的事实。
Codex adapter and health boundary
Wrap version discovery, login/model checks, timeout, cancellation, and error classification. The adapter does not interpret long-term preferences, expand authority, or write the primary database.
Disposable workspace and provenance
Each Run gets an isolated workspace with only Task-Pack inputs mounted. Retain input files, read records, output diffs, and artifact hashes so results remain traceable.
Task Pack and structured result
Define objective, inputs, constraints, output schema, acceptance, and budget. Require fixed fields and reject missing files, unsupported citations, or out-of-scope modifications.
Artifacts, validation, and execution projection
Convert Codex events into ExecutorEvents and record artifacts, citations, validation, Token, model, latency, and failure class. The timeline shows only facts users need.
MVP 任务全生命周期
补齐持久 Run、详情时间线、取消、重试、失败页、产物中心和预算上限。所有动作在 Web 中完成，用户不需要打开终端。
失败解释与恢复入口
每个失败显示发生了什么、影响范围、是否可重试、是否会重复副作用和下一步。无法自动恢复时明确转人工，而不是继续转圈。
练习 Effect 的审批闭环
用本地测试服务或测试账户演示 Effect Preview、批准、拒绝和 Receipt。审批必须绑定动作、参数、范围和过期时间。
15 个真实任务与体验收口
让首位用户完成 15 个真实任务中的至少 10 个，记录成功率、人工分钟、Token、失败与恢复；修复阻塞主路径的文案、布局和状态歧义。
MVP task lifecycle
Complete durable Runs, detail timeline, cancel, retry, failure page, artifact center, and budget limits. All actions work in the browser without opening a terminal.
Failure explanation and recovery
Every failure shows what happened, impact, retryability, duplicate-effect risk, and next step. If automatic recovery is unsafe, hand over explicitly instead of spinning.
Practice-effect approval loop
Use a local test service or test account to demonstrate Effect Preview, approve, reject, and Receipt. Approval binds action, parameters, scope, and expiry.
Fifteen real tasks and UX closeout
Let the first user complete at least 10 of the 15 real tasks and record success, manual minutes, Token, failure, and recovery. Fix copy, layout, and state ambiguity that blocks the main path.
Effect intent 与 outbox
任何外部动作先写 intent 和待发送项，再提交事务，由 Dispatcher 在授权检查后执行。禁止在执行器内部直接调用外部写接口。
Policy、Mandate 与审批
按动作类型、目标、范围、金额或风险等级定义 Mandate；审批卡展示真实参数和不可逆影响。拒绝、过期或权限收缩必须阻止执行。
幂等键、Receipt 与对账
同一逻辑动作复用幂等键；记录外部返回、时间、结果和撤销信息。外部结果不确定时先查询对账，不能把超时当失败后重发。
崩溃、重复与死信演练
注入进程崩溃、重复投递、网络超时和部分成功，确认零重复副作用；死信必须可查看、修复和人工重放，并留下审计。
Effect intent and outbox
Every external action writes intent and an outbox item before commit; Dispatcher executes after authority checks. Executors never call external write APIs directly.
Policy, Mandate, and approval
Define Mandates by action type, target, scope, amount, or risk. The approval card shows real parameters and irreversible impact. Rejection, expiry, or reduced authority blocks execution.
Idempotency key, Receipt, and reconciliation
Reuse the same idempotency key for one logical action and record external response, time, result, and cancellation details. Reconcile uncertainty instead of treating timeout as failure and resending.
Crash, duplicate, and dead-letter drills
Inject crashes, duplicate delivery, network timeout, and partial success; prove zero duplicate effects. Dead letters must be inspectable, repairable, manually replayable, and audited.
跨行业任务族覆盖
从 eval/ 的 15 个任务中再选择至少两个与首批不同的任务族，例如网页归档或 Issue 到 PR。复用同一 Ticket、Run、Artifact 和审批路径，不复制一套旁路系统。
能力路由与模板
为执行器声明 capability，按任务需求路由；任务模板固定输入、输出和验收。路由失败显示缺失能力，不默默降级到不适用的执行器。
恢复、预算与故障注入
补齐 checkpoint、暂停、恢复、预算耗尽和人工接管；运行故障注入和重放，验证不同任务族共享同一恢复语义。
内核加固与审计导出
补 schema migration、事件完整性、产物校验、诊断导出和用户可见审计。移除只在开发机可用的隐藏配置和永久 mock。
Cross-industry task-family coverage

Pick at least two task families from the 15 eval tasks that differ from the first batch, such as web archiving or Issue-to-PR. Reuse the same Ticket, Run, Artifact, and approval paths; do not build a bypass system.
Capability routing and templates

Executors declare capabilities and tasks route by requirement. Templates fix inputs, outputs, and acceptance. Missing capability fails visibly instead of silently falling back to an unsuitable executor.
Recovery, budget, and fault injection
Add checkpoints, pause, resume, budget exhaustion, and human takeover. Run fault injection and replay to prove both task families share the same recovery semantics.
Kernel hardening and audit export
Add schema migration, event integrity, artifact validation, diagnostics export, and a user-visible audit view. Remove hidden development-machine configuration and permanent mocks.
Stage 1 出口审计
逐条收集 MVP、恢复、副作用、任务族和成本门槛的证据，缺一项就停留在当前阶段；不要用后续路线图替代当前验收。
故障与安全复核
完成 200 次故障注入、崩溃恢复、重复投递、越权和秘密检查；记录未解决风险、规避方式和是否阻断发布。
安装与支持文档
从空目录完成安装、启动、创建任务、重启恢复和导出；写清前置条件、已知限制、诊断命令和回滚方式。
发布说明与下一阶段入口
发布 Stage 1 版本说明，说明可用任务族、不能做什么、数据位置和升级路径；把 Stage 2 的只读优先级写进下一阶段入口。
Stage 1 exit audit
Collect evidence for MVP, recovery, side effects, task families, and cost. Stay in this stage if any gate is missing; never replace current acceptance with the later roadmap.
Fault and security review
Run 200 fault injections, crash recovery, duplicate delivery, privilege, and secret checks. Record unresolved risk, mitigation, and release-blocking status.
Installation and support docs
From an empty directory, install, start, create a task, restart, recover, and export. Document prerequisites, known limits, diagnostics, and rollback.
Release notes and next-stage entry
Publish Stage 1 release notes with supported task families, non-goals, data location, and upgrade path. Make Stage 2 read-only priority the entry condition.
